1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Provisions for workmen compensation, insurance, public liability, property damage, insurance etc. to be ensured by the contractor. Also, safety measures prescribed for working in Extra High Voltage & use of personnel protective equipment must be adhered to. 3. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 4. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 5. Service & Support AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. 6. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 7. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. The bidder shall upload the GST registration & GST Returns for the last three months. 2. The bidder must submit the acceptance of terms & condition of bid. 3. The bidder shall submit a undertaking declaring that the firm has never been blacklisted or suspended by any Government Department or Organization. 4. The bidder shall submit a Affidavit declaring whether any close relative or family member of the bidder is employed at Maulana Azad Medical College (MAMC). 5. The bidder must submit the bid security declaration. 6. The proprietor/owner of the bidding firm must possess a valid Police Verification Certificate ( PVC) of engaged drivers. 7. The bidder shall submit copies of valid Driving Licenses of at least 2 drivers along with the T echnical Bid. 8. The bidder must possess a valid ISO 9001:2015 Certificate in the relevant field, issued prior to the publication of the tender. 9. If IP address of the bidder found matching/conflict with other bidders will be disqualified. 10. Only the distance travelled for official duties/use of the vehicle shall be considered for calcul ation i.e. from MAMC to place of Visit and back. .

8. Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) Vehicles will be used for official duties, including transportation of officers, staff, guests, and other as per d irection of higher authorities. Vehicles shall be in good working condition, clean, safe, and properly maintained. Vehicles should have valid registration, insurance, and statutory documents. Provide experienced drivers with valid driving licenses and professional conduct. The service provider shall be responsible for regular maintenance, servicing, repairs, and cleanliness of ve hicles. The salary, wages, allowances, and other benefits of the drivers shall be borne by the service provider. Ensure proper charging arrangements and uninterrupted vehicle operation. Provide replacement vehicle in case of breakdown or non-availability (No extra cost will be paid for replace ment). Maintain compliance with all road safety rules and applicable regulations. Submit monthly bills along with log sheet details for payment processing. Vehicle should be available during office hours and as when required by the office. The deployed drivers shall wear the prescribed uniform during duty hours and maintain a clean, profession al, and presentable appearance at all times while performing official duties. The uniform related expenses shall be borne by the Service Provider.
